author: Ariadne II
title: Analysis v5: Seed Summary (full vs filtered) + γ peak stats
abstract: CPU-only test that aggregates val_mae across trial_{42..45}.json, reports full mean±sd and a filtered mean±sd excluding outliers (val_mae not in [0.015, 0.040]). Also summarizes γ[t] peak index/value across seeds. Writes results to storage/ariadne/analyses/ariadne2_sota_gamma_seed_summary_v2.md.

original_submission.content:
import os, glob, json, numpy as np

def test():
    os.makedirs("storage/ariadne/analyses", exist_ok=True)
    paths = sorted(glob.glob("storage/ariadne/analyses/fourier_learn_gamma_export_v2/trial_*.json"))
    rows = ["# Learnable-γ Seeds: Full vs Filtered Summary", ""]
    rows.append("| seed | val_mae | gamma_peak_t | gamma_peak_val |")
    rows.append("|---:|---:|---:|---:|")

    vals, vals_filt = [], []
    peaks_t, peaks_v = [], []
    for p in paths:
        with open(p, "r") as f:
            d = json.load(f)
        seed = d.get("seed", "n/a")
        v = float(d.get("val_mae"))
        g = np.array(d.get("gamma_profile", []), dtype=float)
        if g.size == 32:
            t_peak = int(np.argmax(g)) + 1  # 1-indexed timestep
            v_peak = float(g.max())
        else:
            t_peak, v_peak = -1, float("nan")
        rows.append(f"| {seed} | {v:.6f} | {t_peak} | {v_peak:.3f} |")
        vals.append(v)
        peaks_t.append(t_peak); peaks_v.append(v_peak)
        if 0.015 <= v <= 0.040:
            vals_filt.append(v)

    def _stat(xs):
        arr = np.array(xs, dtype=float)
        if arr.size == 0:
            return "n/a", "n/a"
        mean = arr.mean()
        sd = arr.std(ddof=1) if arr.size >= 2 else 0.0
        return f"{mean:.6f}", f"{sd:.6f}"

    mean_full, sd_full = _stat(vals)
    mean_f, sd_f = _stat(vals_filt)
    rows += ["", f"full_mean = {mean_full}", f"full_std  = {sd_full}",
             f"filt_mean (0.015–0.040) = {mean_f}", f"filt_std  = {sd_f}"]

    # γ peak stats
    if peaks_t:
        rows += ["", f"gamma_peak_t_mean = {np.mean(peaks_t):.2f}",
                 f"gamma_peak_val_mean = {np.nanmean(peaks_v):.3f}"]
    out = "\n".join(rows) + "\n"
    out_path = "storage/ariadne/analyses/ariadne2_sota_gamma_seed_summary_v2.md"
    with open(out_path, "w") as f:
        f.write(out)
    print(out)
    print(f"[saved] {out_path}")
    return "ok"
